title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: WeVisForensics coordinates self-evolving visual and audio forensic inspector agents under a dual-timescale reinforcement learning policy to detect generated-video artifacts with localized evidence and high accuracy.

title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
summary: A diagnostic benchmark of 180 simulated manipulation configurations evaluates whether embodied systems can combine history-based reasoning, precise execution, and closed-loop environmental feedback, revealing that single-view competence does not transfer to composed tasks.

title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
summary: WeMM-Video is a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models that unify text, image, audio, and video processing for joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, using hybrid thinking modes and large-scale training to achieve strong open-source video understanding results.

title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We…

title: Posterior Matching Distillation
summary: Posterior Matching Distillation trains a stochastic student to match a teacher diffusion model’s full posterior via tilted mean constraints, enabling high-quality few-step image generation without auxiliary score networks.

title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
summary: A task-adaptive agentic framework utilizes 3D proxies, physics simulation, and multi-agent coordination to enhance the structural control, physical plausibility, and visual realism of generated videos.

title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
summary: A plug-and-play objective, VODA, groups per-pixel contributors by local depth to supervise all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, improving volumetric segmentation and enabling evaluation via Removal-3D and Removal Depth Error.

title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
summary: A single scalable network estimates dense metric depth for images and video at native resolution, jointly improving metric accuracy, boundary sharpness, and temporal consistency.

title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
summary: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing…

title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
summary: A statistical test, AltRA-Test, determines when large language models can replace human annotators by comparing inter-annotator agreement in resampled mixed human-LLM panels, and evaluations show it often requires about 100 items and makes better replacement decisions than baselines.

title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
summary: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper,…

title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
summary: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragg…

title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
summary: ZeroVLN is a slow-fast vision-language navigation framework that avoids navigation-domain supervised fine-tuning of the VLM brain by using a semantic tool-calling interface and closed-loop reinforcement learning to coordinate a language-based brain with an action expert, improving VLN-CE performance while preserving g…

title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
summary: A fixed set of steering vectors added to a frozen diffusion transformer recovers most of the quality gains from reinforcement learning post-training, indicating that much of the improvement comes from a constant shift rather than prompt-specific transformations.

title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
summary: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. World action models (WAMs) have emerged as effective language-conditioned manipulation policies, but are pretrained for robot arms and sample slowly…

title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
summary: AFFECT, an auxiliary objective that trains world models to match visual responses to temporally correlated action noise, improves rollout fidelity and planning success in simulated and real robotic tasks.

title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
summary: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-dr…

title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
summary: WM^MLLM uses multimodal large language models to maintain an external panorama state with revision history, enabling persistent, editable world generation from a single image with exact revisits and local edits.

title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining
summary: LightningMoBA combines dynamic routing, KV-centric ownership, and runtime pipelining to accelerate long-context attention while maintaining or improving quality.

title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
summary: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable…

title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
summary: FlashMorph2 performs on-policy layer selection and weight adaptation for hybrid attention Transformers, improving long-context benchmark scores while selecting layers efficiently across model scales.

title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detect…

title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
summary: Critique overlap among peer reviews is rising, and reviews identified as LLM-generated are less distinct from each other, indicating decreasing diversity of critiques.

title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
summary: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have…

title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
summary: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to…

title: Embeddings vs. Grep: Rethinking the Dense Advantage in Code Search
summary: Code-search benchmarks show dense encoders well ahead of BM25, yet coding agents do well with grep. What does this dense advantage measure? Existing benchmarks cannot tell: they use curated queries, old code and a handicapped BM25. To find out, we build Repo-Premium, a realistic repository-level code-search benchmark.…

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our eval…

title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
summary: A local System 1 agent framework compiles tool schemas and requests into multiple-choice questions answered by a one-pass decision model, enabling accurate biomedical tool calls without text generation or invented content.

title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: VSpark accelerates autoregressive vision-language-action models by improving speculative decoding with calibrated action-noise rollouts, hidden-feature alignment, and reuse of rejected-draft continuations, achieving lossless 1.28x–2.10x speedups across multiple robot manipulation tasks.

title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
summary: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and…

title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any cam…

title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show t…

title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
summary: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilitie…

title: DailySafe: Benchmarking Dynamic Safety Awareness in Everyday Multi-Turn Multimodal Interactions
summary: A new benchmark, DailySafe, evaluates the ability of multimodal large language models to maintain safety and address evolving risks within complex, multi-turn, real-world interactions.

title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
summary: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share t…

title: Do Probing and Steering Favor the Same Directions Within and Across Language Models?
summary: The best direction for probing a concept in a language model's hidden state is not the best direction for steering the model toward that concept, with implications for transfer and abstention.

title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
summary: O2LaF repurposes a shared pretrained video model to learn inverse and forward latent action dynamics from unlabeled videos, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot action probing and zero-shot action transfer.

title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
summary: An LLM-based pipeline audits simulated manipulation success checkers by recreating disagreement scenarios and visually verifying whether observed behavior satisfies task instructions, revealing phantom successes and silent failures.

title: S1CogBench: What System One Decision Models Can and Cannot Do on Cognitive Experiments
summary: S1CogBench evaluates System One decision models on 24 cognitive tasks, revealing that fast decisions often lack evidence-based reasoning and vary widely in reliability.

title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
summary: A coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone by reparametrizing it with interpretable optical elements, achieving better classification and image encoding than gradient-free methods and approaching backpropagation through a calibrated model at lower cost.
